title: Bitcoin Price Crashes Over 5% to $75,000 as Tech Rout Wipes Out Leveraged Longs
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Crashes Over 5% to $75,000 as Tech Rout Wipes Out Leveraged Longs Bitcoin price fell from above $80,800 to near $76,600 on Thursday morning as a Nasdaq selloff in chip and AI stocks spilled into crypto. This post Bitcoin Price Crashes Over 5% to $75,000 as Tech Rout Wipes Out Leveraged Longs first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
